# Commit Message for v1.0.0 Release

## Title
```
chore: release v1.0.0
```

## Body
```
Release Automate platform v1.0.0 — Initial MVP

This release marks the first production-ready version of the unified
Automate platform, delivering AI-orchestrated QA capabilities with live
Playwright monitoring, failure triage, and quality gates.

## Package Versions
All workspace packages bumped from 0.1.0 to 1.0.0:
- @automate/api
- @automate/unified-web
- @automate/db
- @automate/auth
- @automate/realtime
- @automate/shared-contracts
- @automate/ui
- @automate/migrate-cli

## Changes
### Added
- CHANGELOG.md with comprehensive v1.0.0 release notes
- LICENSE file (MIT License)
- RELEASE-v1.0.0.md with detailed release documentation
- Version badge in README.md

### Fixed
- TypeScript compilation errors in dashboard/index.ts (missing type imports)
- Hono Context type extraction in reporter.ts multipart parsing

### Improved
- TODO comments now reference post-MVP roadmap with better context
- InMemoryRunRepository fallback properly documented as dev/test only
- Feature-flagged capabilities clearly marked in code comments

## Verification
✓ All 28 Turborepo tasks passing (pnpm verify)
✓ Zero TypeScript compilation errors
✓ 366 unit tests passing with high coverage (93%+ API, 91%+ Web)
✓ E2E test suite passing
✓ Security scans clean (Semgrep, gitleaks, pnpm audit)
✓ No ESLint warnings

## Breaking Changes
- API routes now prefixed with /api/v1
- Database migrated from SQLite to PostgreSQL 16
- Environment variable changes (SQLITE_PATH → DATABASE_URL)

See CHANGELOG.md and docs/migration-guide.md for full details.

## MVP Scope
✓ Live run monitoring
✓ Playwright reporter ingestion
✓ Failure triage with artifacts
✓ Quality gates and quarantine management
✓ API key authentication

Post-MVP features remain feature-flagged and disabled by default.

Closes #TBD
```

## Git Commands
```bash
# Add all changes
git add .

# Commit with message
git commit -F .github/COMMIT_MSG_v1.0.0.txt

# Tag the release
git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "Release v1.0.0 — Initial MVP

Unified Automate platform with live Playwright monitoring, failure triage,
quality gates, and comprehensive QA tooling.

See CHANGELOG.md for full release notes."

# Push to remote
git push origin main --tags
```

## Post-Release Checklist
- [ ] Verify GitHub Actions CI passes on tagged commit
- [ ] Confirm Docker images published successfully
- [ ] Update project documentation website
- [ ] Announce release on team channels
- [ ] Create v1.1.0 milestone and roadmap issue
- [ ] Monitor error tracking for first 24 hours
